item.title: UWSA Linked to Quartz Mining Operation in Northern Shan State
item.description: Residents in Tangyan Township, northern Shan State, allege that the United Wa State Army (UWSA) is collaborating with Chinese mining investors to extract quartz from Loi Lao Mountain in the Pan Nyawng village tract, raising concerns over land seizures, environmental damage, and a lack of transparency.
